fusions.name: Closed Grip
fusions.desc: A seizing strike that deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and moves it 30% slower for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Final Grip
fusions.desc: A steady strike that deals 16 damage to a target at or below 25% health, up to 1.5 times that at its maximum reach of 6 tiles.

fusions.name: Steady Hands
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Sure Aim
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 10%. Your armour also rises by 5%.
